summaryZh: Jiang Laboratory 研究正常与癌症干细胞中的 RNA 和 DNA 编辑机制、编辑酶调控及其治疗靶向。研究使用生物信息学、分子与细胞生物学工具、患者样本和异种移植小鼠模型。
researchQuestions: RNA 和 DNA 编辑酶在不同细胞环境中如何受到调控，又如何靶向这些通路？

evidence.quote: The Jiang Laboratory studies the molecular mechanisms of RNA and DNA editing in normal and cancer stem cells, how these editase enzymes are regulated in different cellular contexts, and how to target these pathways
We employ a variety of bioinformatic, molecular and cell biological tools, as well as patient samples and xenograft mouse models
She is currently an Assistant Professor of Medicine in the Division of Regenerative Medicine at the University of California, San Diego.
